name: Git lookups
responsibility: Asks Git which repository a directory belongs to, what that repository is called on every machine, and what a checkout has out
description: repoRootOf, repoIdentityAt and inspectCheckout (the branch, commit and worktrees of a checkout) go out through ./checkouts. The registry, the vault finder and the vault's Git checkout read it inside workspace, and the model store asks it for the root of a checkout and the identity of its repository (TASK-653.15).
